desc:
👊 Welcome to Shazam Battlegrounds!

Shazam Battlegrounds is an open-world, free-roam superhero game where you can harness the powers of your favorite heroes. Soar through the skies and battle like a true champion!

🎮 Available on: PS5, PS4, Xbox, Mobile, PC
⭐ Enjoying the game? Like and favorite it!

📌 Join the group for exclusive characters:
🔗 https://www.roblox.com/communities/10734279/Nexon-Games#!/about

🎮 Controls:

Desktop / Gamepad

[1] / [X] = Move 1
[2] / [Y] = Move 2
[3] / [A] = Move 3
[4] / [B] = Move 4
